geography.text: Energy requirements is based on environmental report of Italian company. Total leakages are specific for CH, HD-leakages are calculated out of the total with German data.

technology.text: The quantity of gas delivered in the high and medium pressure network is estimated. Industry, power plants and half of commercial and of others are assumed to be connected to the high and medium pressure network .
